scope: VOD movies and TV; sports/live excluded

criteria.minimumQuality: HD rendition at least 1920 pixels wide or 1080 high, including cropped films

browserProof.title: Interstellar
browserProof.note: Advancing video observed; not a controlled startup or stability measurement.

failuresObserved: Tiki: selection returned to Lul; not counted as a distinct success

retainedCinejoyEvidence: hls-providers-2026-09-24.json currentDomainRetest establishes all three servers support HD, despite current failures for Lisbon/Solara

rankPolicy.note: Nebula remains the requested CineJoy default and won the current production sample (3/3). Lul and Link each passed 2/3, with Lul faster on the Mini. Lisbon/Solara retain previously verified HD capability but failed fresh lookup trials, so are last-resort backups. Weights are policy tiers, not latency estimates.

integrationCorrections.Link: Lookup uses aether.ist; media requires nextgencloudfabric.com referrer. Without it, segments return 403.
integrationCorrections.Lul: Resolver and playback share Chrome 150 UA. Omit Accept-Language: the same master and child return 200 without it and 403 with it. No new curl transport or browser process is needed.
integrationCorrections.redirects: Every redirect uses the DNS-pinned provider client and is checked for HTTPS/public destinations. Masters have a 2 MiB aggregate cap.

limitations: Short samples, not a guarantee of upstream uptime or all-title coverage.
Link TV masters sampled at 720p are intentionally rejected; this is an expected quality exclusion.
Lul Oppenheimer lookup failed. Breaking Bad decoded 1920x1080 but its 21-second startup left too little of the 30-second trial for the required steady window. This remains a failed trial.
CineJoy Lisbon and Solara retained for previously verified HD capability; fresh lookup failures are preserved in this report.
AAC tracks confirmed via ffprobe for Lul. Automated browser tests prove advancing decoded video, not physical-device audio or battery efficiency.

The public sample had 7 successful full-HD playback trials out of 15. Link TV exclusion is expected by the HD-only policy. Failed upstream lookups are retained, not counted as playback successes. This does not establish phone playback or battery efficiency.

productionPlayback.window: 5 seconds continuous advance plus 15 seconds steady playback, 60-second total trial budget
productionPlayback.isolation: Fresh pinned resolves, health events suppressed, progress/history writes blocked, source identity checked
